name: Stage 21: Malmköping to Hagtorp, väg 53
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 21, Malmköping to Hagtorp, väg 53.
utilities: Malmköping/Hosjön is the strong start service node with paid camping/lodging, water, bathing, food, grocery, hotel/lodging, parking, toilets/showers, grill place, and bus access.
Hotel Malmköping sits early on the route by Plevnahöjden and is a practical opening-hour-dependent food/water/refill option.

Malmköping busstation is the real public-transport start access. Current terminal-map data lists a WC, but this should still be treated as station-facility-dependent rather than trail infrastructure. No regular train serves Malmköping; Museispårvägen/Malmakvarn/Hosjö are seasonal heritage tram stops, not commute rail.

There are no confirmed shelters or toilets between Malmköping and Hagtorp. Hagtorp/road 53 is mainly a rural road/trail endpoint; Bäckåsen is the practical nearby bus option. Sagostigen is seasonal/paid/off-route and should not be treated as a shortcut through the currently closed Rosmossen loop.
waterSources: Reliable water is at Malmköping services/camping before departure and the official natural spring at Sundbysjön after about 3 km.
Sundbysjön spring is natural/untested despite being officially listed; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.
Navestasjön, Nälen, and other wetland/lake contexts are natural water only and should not be shown as potable refills.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10.5 km; Naturkartan also lists 10.5 km and its current geometry measures about 10.598 km, Äventyrligare lists 10.58 km, OSM relation 3854541 measures about 10.59-10.62 km but is tagged 11 km and partly stale at the Malmköping start, and local official-GPX route geometry is about 10.37 km.

Route character: starts at Malmköping camping/Hosjön, climbs Plevnahöjden and Strömsholmsåsen, crosses Eskilstunavägen, continues through Malma reserve with Sundbysjön views and spring, then passes Navestasjön, the old overgrown road, Mordgrind, the moving-island pond, Nälen bird-lake context, and the 1876 execution site before Hagtorp/road 53.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Comments from 2023 praised waymarking; one 2023 report mentioned a single tree over the trail in Malma reserve that was easy to pass, and an August 2024 report warned of nettles/high meadow vegetation and light hilliness. A May 2025 AllTrails report described dry, well-maintained conditions with some hills and trafficked crossings.

Recent independent reports also note trafficked road crossings, road-adjacent walking, narrow/steep esker footing and benches/viewpoints on the ridges. A 2024 hiker report heard/seen traffic near road 53, crossed busy roads, found a substantial beaver-felled tree at a creek crossing, and still described the stage as very beautiful and well maintained.

Use local official-GPX-derived geometry for route-builder snapping: Stage 20/21 and 21/22 join exactly in local data. Naturkartan is also topologically clean, with Stage 20 ending exactly at Stage 21 start 59.139547667,16.731869529 and Stage 22 starting exactly at Stage 21 end 59.197098814,16.616318951. Treat official, Naturkartan, local and OSM endpoint coordinates as aliases rather than separate trailheads.

OSM relation 3854541 is graph-connected but should not be consumed in raw member order. The recommended Malmköping-to-Hagtorp way order is 372219224 reversed, 260509383 forward, 290703200 forward, 133302174 reversed, 290703201 reversed, 290703203 forward, 290703198 reversed, 1351896052 reversed, 290137322 reversed, 290137319 forward, 449055660 forward, 290137340 forward, 290137357 forward, 290137361 forward, 1295267625 forward, 290137317 forward, 1294590071 forward, 1294590072 forward, 290137318 forward, 290137312 forward, 290137321 forward, 290137314 forward, 290137326 forward, 290137315 forward, and 290137349 reversed.
Grazing animals matter: Sörmlandsleden and Naturkartan both warn that heifers/bulls can occur in Malma reserve, and horses/sheep can occur near Hagtorp.

Malma reserve rules: no loose dogs or other free-running pets, no tenting or caravan setup, fires only at assigned places, no parking outside prepared places, no damaging geological formations, plants, trees or bushes, no disturbing wildlife, and riding only where permitted.

Malmköpings reserve near the start has old forest and bark-beetle/dead-spruce context; Länsstyrelsen removed hazardous dead trees in 2023 but still warns that some dead trees can fall. Do not damage living or dead trees, shrubs, plants, fungi or lichens, and organized camp activity requires permission.

Do not show a wind shelter or verified public toilet between Hosjöbadet/Malmköping and Hagtorp on Stage 21 itself. The next clear hiking shelter is Hällaren on Stage 22, about 4 km after Hagtorp. Sagostigen near Hagtorp is seasonal/paid/off-route and should be treated as a deliberate detour, not a dependable trail facility or trail shortcut.

Rundslinga 22.2/Rosmossen is currently closed for safety because of severe bark-beetle-damaged forest; do not recommend Sagostigen/Rosmossen as an alternate continuation unless Sörmlandsleden updates that closure.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping water point
facilities.description: Mapped water point by Malmköpings Bad & Camping / Hosjön. Strongest reliable refill before Sundbysjön, but service/seasonal access can matter.

facilities.name: Malmköpings Bad & Camping services
facilities.description: Paid camping/service start with toilets, showers, kitchen, drinking-water context, cabins/youth-hostel/camping, cafe/restaurant/kiosk context, sauna and beach access. Opening hours and customer/seasonal access vary.

facilities.name: Malmköping camping parking
facilities.description: Parking/access by Malmköpings Bad & Camping / Hosjöbadet at the stage start; check local signs and camping/seasonal rules.

facilities.name: Hosjöbadet toilets and bathing services
facilities.description: Municipal bathing area by the stage start with toilets, changing hut, kiosk, grill, dog-bath context, camping/cabins nearby, jetties and accessibility ramp. Services and sampling are seasonal.

facilities.name: Hosjöbadet beach rules
facilities.description: Municipal beach rules: no dogs on the main beach except designated dog-bath/access areas, no smoking, no fishing in the bathing area, and bathing-water sampling is seasonal. 2026 official sampling season is June 21-August 15.

facilities.name: Hosjön grill place
facilities.description: Two fireplaces by Hosjöbadet/Malmköpings Bad & Camping. Bring your own firewood or charcoal and use only when current fire rules allow; fire bans override fixed grill places.

facilities.name: Hemköp Malmköping Torget
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply in town before/near the start. Check current opening hours before relying on it.

facilities.name: Coop Malmköping
facilities.description: Additional town grocery/resupply option about 0.7-0.8 km from the stage start. Opening hours should be checked live.

facilities.name: Malmköpings Wärdshus
facilities.description: Nearby restaurant/lodging in Malmköping town, about 0.8-1 km from the stage-start context. Opening hours and booking availability should be checked live.

facilities.name: Malmköping busstation
facilities.description: Practical start access about 0.7 km/10 minutes from the stage start, with regional bus lines including 337, 430, 479, 690, 691, 701 and 801 in terminal-map context. Terminal-map data lists WC, but verify live/local availability; no regular train serves Malmköping and heritage tram stops are not commute rail.

facilities.name: Hotel Malmköping refill/services
facilities.description: Hotel/restaurant and possible water/provisions option early on the stage by Plevnahöjden; opening-hour and customer-service dependent.

facilities.name: Plevnahöjden / Malmabacken
facilities.description: Early ridge/high-point context with historical military associations and benches/views before the trail follows Strömsholmsåsen; expect narrow/steep esker footing in places.

facilities.name: Malmköping reserve dead-tree and rules context
facilities.description: Old-forest reserve near the start. Dead spruce was removed from trails in 2023, but Länsstyrelsen still warns some dead trees can fall; do not damage living/dead trees, shrubs, plants, fungi or lichens, and organized camp activity/competitions require permission.

facilities.name: Malma reserve grazing and rules
facilities.description: Heifers/bulls can occur north of Sundbyvägen and sheep south of it. No loose dogs, no tenting/caravans, fires only at assigned places, no parking outside prepared places, no unauthorized riding, and avoid damaging plants/trees/geology.

facilities.name: Malma reserve / Smedstavägen access
facilities.description: Reserve-side parking/info-board access along road 53 between the two grazing enclosures. Useful bailout/access but verify current road/parking signs.

facilities.name: Smedstavägen bus access
facilities.description: Mid-stage bus/bailout context near Malma reserve, named by Länsstyrelsen for access. It is access, not services; check live service before planning around it.

facilities.name: Sundbysjön spring
facilities.description: Official spring after about 3 km with views over Sundbysjön/Dunkerbygden. Natural source: filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

facilities.name: Sundbysjön rest/source area
facilities.description: Rest context near the spring and bird-rich Sundbysjön. Do not treat the lake/wetland as potable water.

facilities.name: Navestasjön
facilities.description: Natural lake/view context before the old overgrown road and Mordgrind. Lake water only, not a mapped refill.

facilities.name: Mordgrind
facilities.description: Historic murder site where engineer Herman Upmark was killed in 1874; Hjert and Tector were later the last publicly executed people in Sweden. Approximate route-derived pin; no exact mapped POI was verified.

facilities.name: Moving-island pond / Smedkärret candidate
facilities.description: Inferred marker for the official moving-island pond story near Navesta, likely Smedkärret with an underground connection to Akaren. Exact official pond name is not explicit; treat as approximate.

facilities.name: Nälen bird-lake context
facilities.description: Lake glimpsed from the route; official text notes Stone Age settlement finds and describes Nälen as one of Sörmland's notable bird lakes. Natural water only.

facilities.name: Hagtorp horse/sheep pasture warning
facilities.description: Near the end before Hagtorp, horses and sheep can occur along the trail. Keep dogs controlled, give animals space, and close gates.

facilities.name: Hjert execution site / Lidamon
facilities.description: Approximate marker for the Lidamon/gallows/execution-place context before the endpoint; Hjert was publicly executed here in 1876. No precise public coordinate was verified, and occasional secondary-source date errors should be ignored.

facilities.name: Hagtorp / road 53 stage end
facilities.description: Stage-21/22 boundary near road 53. Endpoint is not a service hub and no dedicated public parking was verified; use live planning for road/bus logistics and watch traffic at the road edge.

facilities.name: Bäckåsen bus access
facilities.description: Practical nearby bus option roughly 1 km from the Hagtorp endpoint; useful for stage-21 exit planning only when service is running. Weekday, school-day, weekend and roadwork/replacement patterns can differ, so verify current Sörmlandstrafiken departures day-of.

facilities.name: Sagostigen seasonal cafe/toilets/parking detour
facilities.description: Seasonal paid attraction near the Hagtorp end, about 1-1.5 km off the stage endpoint depending on route. For 2026 it lists opening May 14-August 23 plus August 29-30, with cafe generally 10-16 in season and paid-entry toilet/parking context. Treat as a deliberate detour, not an on-route facility or shortcut through Rosmossen while 22.2 is closed.

facilities.name: Landsvägsgatan road crossing
facilities.description: Road-crossing/approach context near the early stage after Malmköping. Use care with dogs, children and low visibility.

facilities.name: Eskilstunavägen / road 53-55 crossing
facilities.description: Primary-road approach/crossing cluster. User reports mention trafficked crossings and road noise/visibility in this stage segment.

facilities.name: Route 53 crossing / road-adjacent point
facilities.description: Mid-stage route-53 crossing or road-adjacent context; pause and confirm the marked line before crossing.

facilities.name: Ekebyvägen road crossing
facilities.description: Rural-road crossing/context in the later half of Stage 21. Watch for traffic and visibility, especially at dusk or with dogs.

facilities.name: Hagtorp road 53 endpoint crossing
facilities.description: Road-53 endpoint context at Hagtorp. The stage end is not a service hub, so plan pickup/bus logistics away from traffic.

facilities.name: Stage 21 hunting-season awareness
facilities.description: Seasonal hunting awareness, not a closure: Södermanland elk hunting commonly runs October 8-January 31 in licensed/management areas, with short calf hunting on unregistered land. Wear high visibility and respect posted hunt notices.

facilities.name: Stage 21 nettles/meadow vegetation
facilities.description: August 2024 official-page comment warned of lots of meadow/nettle wading and recommended long trousers. Expect seasonal vegetation and tick exposure in pasture/meadow parts.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Stage lakes and wetland contexts are not automatic fishing opportunities. Fishing in inland waters generally requires checking fishing rights or buying a fishing card unless a local free-fishing exception is verified.
